title: BIT Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: BIT Support Engineer** 

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Experience: 5–10 Years**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time** 

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled BIT Support Engineer (L2/L3\) to manage and support our enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments. The role involves handling critical incidents, ensuring high system availability, and acting as an escalation point for complex technical issues in a 24x7 operational setup.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and manage IT infrastructure using 24x7 monitoring tools
* Act as L2/L3 escalation point for complex incidents (P1/P2\) and perform root cause analysis (RCA)
* Administer and support Windows/Linux servers and enterprise applications
* Configure and manage network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs)
* Manage Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) including policies, failover, and performance tuning
* Support data center operations including servers, SAN storage, and virtualization platforms
* Administer VMware/ESXi environments (VM provisioning, snapshots, cluster health)
* Manage and support cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Handle Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure AD, MFA)
* Ensure infrastructure security using antivirus, EDR tools, and security best practices
* Lead or support IT infrastructure projects (migrations, upgrades, deployments)
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, DR plans, and knowledge base
* Coordinate with vendors/TAMs for issue resolution and hardware/software support
* Mentor and guide junior engineers and improve team performance
* Ensure compliance with IT security standards and regulatory requirements

Required Skills \& Expertise

Technical Skills

* Strong experience in L2/L3 Support \& Incident Management (ITIL framework)
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Windows Server \& Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu)
* Networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, Routers, Switches)
* Firewalls (NGFW – Palo Alto, Fortinet, etc.)
* Virtualization (VMware/ESXi)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Azure AD)
* Knowledge of SAN Storage \& Data Center operations
* Familiarity with security tools (EDR, Antivirus) and compliance standards (ISO, PCI, GDPR)

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in IT, Electronics, or related field
* Relevant certifications preferred:
* CCNA / CCNP
* Microsoft Certified
* AWS / Azure / Cloud certifications

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations (critical outages)
* Good communication \& stakeholder management skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Team player with mentoring capabilities

**Note that the candidate would be required to work in rotational shift(morning, night and general).**

Work Location: In person

title: T&T - Customer -CS&D | Customer Experience | Ahmedabad | Manager
description:
**T\&T \- Customer \-CS\&D \| Customer Experience \| Ahmedabad \| Manager**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 113183
* **Location**: Ahmedabad
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team:**

  



Customer is about much more than just the numbers. It’s about attesting to accomplishments and challenges and helping to assure strong foundations for future aspirations. Deloitte exemplifies the what, how, and why of change so you’re always ready to act ahead. Learn more about Customer

  


**Role Requirements**

  


* The Assurance Lead will operate within Conversational Banking / Contact Center Tramsformation (CCT) program, supporting the transformation of customer interactions across digital, AI‑enabled, and assisted channels.
* This role is critical in ensuring that programme delivery meets risk appetite, regulatory obligations, and internal control standards while enabling safe, scalable, and customer‑centric innovation.
* The role will work closely with Technology, Digital, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Data Privacy, and Governance teams to embed assurance from programme inception through delivery and implementation.
* Rapid navigation of governance, policies, and assurance expectations.

  


**Key Responsibilities**

  



1\. Establish Assurance Requirements and Framework (CCT Context)


* Define a CCT‑specific assurance framework aligned to client's Group standards, policies, and regulatory expectations (e.g. conduct risk, data privacy, operational resilience, model risk where applicable).
* Translate client's risk appetite and control frameworks into programme‑specific assurance requirements covering conversational AI, customer data usage, integration with legacy banking platforms, and outsourcing/third‑party dependencies.
* Partner with 1st and 2nd Lines of Defence, Compliance Advisory, Privacy Office, and Group Risk to align assurance expectations across the programme.
* Ensure consistency with client's Technology Control Frameworks, Change Frameworks, and Global Transformation standards.

  



2\. Early Risk \& Control Identification (Conversational Banking Focus)


* Identify key risks associated with Conversational Banking delivery, including: Customer harm and conduct riskData protection and privacy (PII, consent, retention)Technology resilience and availabilityAI / automation controls (where applicable)Third‑party and vendor risk
* Design and embed appropriate controls into: CCT delivery plans and release cyclesRAID logs and risk registersProduct and solution design documentation
* Proactively identify governance, control, or ownership gaps and influence timely mitigation before risks materialise.

  



3\. Governance Structures and Forums


* Advise on and support the establishment of effective governance across the CCT programme, including: Design authoritiesRisk and control forumsProgramme steering and stage‑gate reviews
* Clarify escalation routes and decision authorities aligned to governance models.
* Provide clear, structured assurance insights to senior sponsors and governance committees to support defensible decision‑making.

  



4\. Assurance Plan Development


* Develop and maintain a clear, structured assurance plan aligned to the CCT delivery lifecycle.
* Define: Scope and objectives of assurance activities
* Review cadence aligned to sprints, releases, and milestones
* Evidence requirements and approval checkpointsEnsure assurance activities are embedded into delivery plans without impeding agile execution.

  



5\. Control Design Challenge

  


* Independently assess and challenge the design and effectiveness of controls proposed by delivery teams.
* Ensure controls are: Robust and compliant with standards
* Proportionate to conversational banking risks
* Practical within agile and iterative delivery models
* Provide constructive challenge to strengthen design decisions while maintaining delivery momentum.

  


**Level of Experience Required** 6 to 9 years

  


**Location and way of working**


* + Location\- Ahemdabad
	+ Working from the office at least 3 days a week is mandatory, with a hybrid model tailored to each domain’s specific needs
	+ Education : MCA/ Mtech/ MBA/ B. Tech/ BBA/ BSC/ BE/ B.Com

title: Business Strategist intern
description:
**Location:** On\-site, Ahmedabad (This is strictly not a remote role)

**Salary:** ₹14,000 – ₹22,000 per month (After 6 months of internship)

**The Reality of This Role:**  
This is a high\-agency position. You will not be fetching coffee or doing mindless data entry. You will be building outreach systems, researching markets, and directly supporting business growth. If you are looking for a passive, hand\-holding, 9\-to\-5 job, do not apply. We need someone who takes ownership and figures things out.

* Build, refine, and execute targeted email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to automate research, draft communications, and analyze campaign data.
* Track pipeline metrics and help the leadership team refine lead\-generation strategies.

**What We Require:**

* **Strong English:** Strong written and spoken communication is non\-negotiable.
* **Platform Knowledge:** Practical basic understanding of LinkedIn navigation, lead generation, and basic email marketing.

title: Gift City Branch - Market Operations Lead, Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join JPMorganChase's India GIFT City buildout and lead a front\-line operations team at the center of trade lifecycle delivery. You will manage complex post\-trade processes across multiple markets products, strengthen controls, and drive automation and process improvements. This is a high\-visibility role for an experienced operations leader who can deliver results under pressure, develop talent, and partner effectively across trading, technology, risk, and compliance.  

  

As a Vice President Market Operations based in the GIFT City branch (Ahmedabad), you will lead a highly visible operations function responsible for end\-to\-end post‑trade delivery. You will own service delivery, controls, and regulatory compliance across products including foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, and money markets. Reporting to the India Branch Head of Operations, you will lead a team, drive measurable improvements in efficiency and straight\-through processing, and partner closely with the front office and key control functions to deliver stable, well\-controlled operations.

 **Job responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end post\-trade delivery, including trade capture and validation, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, break management, investigations, and issue resolution.
* Own service performance outcomes, improving accuracy, timeliness, straight\-through processing, and client experience.
* Strengthen the risk and control environment through disciplined control execution, issue management, remediation, and audit readiness.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies, maintaining strong governance, documentation, and operating discipline.
* Lead, coach, and develop the team, ensuring clear accountability, effective coverage, and operational resiliency.
* Partner with sales and trading, technology, risk, compliance, and finance teams to resolve exceptions and deliver change effectively.
* Drive automation and process improvements, including workflow redesign, data quality enhancements, and operational dashboards.
* Provide clear reporting on key performance indicators, incidents, control issues, and change delivery progress.

 **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree
* Minimum 15 years of experience in markets operations, post\-trade, middle office, or trade support, with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership across at least one of: foreign exchange, rates derivatives, options, fixed income, or money markets.
* Proven people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and building a strong controls culture.
* Strong knowledge of post\-trade processes, including confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, and investigations.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements, such as reduced breaks, faster turnaround times, higher straight\-through processing, or automation benefits.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to use data and key performance indicators to manage performance and prioritize risk.  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience working in a regulated markets environment, with familiarity with India and emerging markets operating considerations.
* Experience leading change or transformation initiatives in operations in partnership with technology teams.
* Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI\-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to improve operational efficiency and accuracy, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, well\-controlled execution through coaching, change adoption, and continuous improvement

**ABOUT US**
  

  

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first\-class business in a first\-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long\-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Back Office Executive
description:
Back Office Executive

**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Salary:** Up to ₹15,000 per month  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive **Back Office Executive** to support our day\-to\-day administrative and digital operations. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with Google Workspace, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, and AI tools such as ChatGPT.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle day\-to\-day back\-office and administrative tasks efficiently.
* Manage professional communication through **Gmail, WhatsApp, and other business communication channels**.
* Create, update, and maintain records using **Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Forms**.
* Perform online research and gather relevant information using **Google and advanced search operators**.
* Search for and collect relevant profiles/information through **LinkedIn**.
* Use **ChatGPT and other AI tools** to assist with research, documentation, content preparation, and daily tasks.
* Maintain accurate data, records, reports, and documentation.
* Coordinate with internal teams whenever required and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Follow up on pending tasks and maintain proper status updates.
* Ensure all information is organized and easily accessible.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and employee\-related information.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Forms**.
* Good understanding of **LinkedIn** and online research.
* Experience using **ChatGPT or similar AI tools**.
* Good written **English communication skills**.
* Knowledge of **advanced Google searches/operators**.
* Good typing, documentation, and data\-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to multitask and manage tasks within deadlines.
* Basic problem\-solving and analytical skills.

Experience

* **1–2 years of relevant experience** in back\-office, administration, data management, research, or a similar role.

Candidate Profile

* Proactive and responsible.
* Quick learner and comfortable using new digital tools.
* Organized and detail\-oriented.
* Able to work independently as well as coordinate with a team.
* Good internet research and information\-gathering skills.

Pay: ₹11,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior IT Manager
description:
**Job Title:** IT Manager

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 5\+ Years  
**Department:** Information Technology

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **IT Manager** to manage IT infrastructure, servers, cloud environments, hosting, IT support, and information security. The role requires both **technical hands\-on expertise and team/vendor management**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage **Linux/Windows servers, networks, cloud infrastructure, and endpoint devices**.
* Manage **AWS/Azure/GCP, web hosting, domains, DNS, SSL, CDN, and server environments**.
* Lead IT support/helpdesk operations and ensure timely issue resolution.
* Manage **IT security, firewalls, endpoint protection, patching, backups, and disaster recovery**.
* Handle IT vendors, ISPs, SaaS platforms, hosting providers, and outsourced support.
* Manage employee **IT onboarding/offboarding, user accounts, devices, and access**.
* Plan and execute **IT infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and technology projects**.
* Maintain IT documentation, asset registers, SOPs, network diagrams, and runbooks.
* Supervise and mentor IT support/system administration teams.
* Support **automation, scripting, CI/CD, Git workflows, and AI\-based IT solutions**.

* **5\+ years** of experience in IT Management or Senior Systems Administration.
* Strong knowledge of **Linux/Windows Server Administration**.
* Experience with **AWS, Azure, or GCP**.
* Strong understanding of **IT security, firewalls, vulnerability management, and endpoint security**.
* Experience managing **IT Helpdesk/Service Desk and SLAs**.
* Knowledge of **DNS, SSL, CDN, domain management, and web hosting**.
* Strong vendor management, documentation, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Bachelor's degree/diploma in **IT, Computer Science, or related field**.
